text:
olivia: Quick question  we have a contractor asking for a partial-day swap during the holiday blackout (Dec 31 morning only). Current PTO rules say contractors need manager sign-off but blackout makes it messy. Can contractors use the same `/pto-swap` flow or do we require manual HR approval?

ben: If it's partial-day and doesn't affect an on-call, manager sign-off + replacement ok. But contractors: we should check billing/engagement docs. Also contractors might not be in our rotation tool.

leo: Timezone gotcha: the contractor is APAC and the shift overlaps midnight for US owners. Our rota marks shifts in UTC; partial-day detection is fuzzy. Can we add `start/end tz` to the swap command?

emily: +1 on timezone. Also payroll cutoff: if this is billed hours we need approval before payroll freeze (Jan 1 00:00 UTC). That means auto-approve only if request submitted >=5 days before cutoff.

harpreet: From policy POV I propose: (1) Contractors follow same `/pto-swap` but require HR acknowledgement for any blackout swap; (2) Partial-day swaps must include exact timezone timestamps; (3) If replacement isn't in rotation, swap goes to manual review; (4) For payroll-sensitive contractors, require finance OK. Sounds heavier but protects billing.

olivia: That sounds reasonable. Can we make the `/pto-swap` command prompt these checks? Example payload:```/pto-swap @contractor -> @sarah 2025-12-31 09:00-13:00 TZ:Asia/Kolkata contractor:yes payroll-affects:yes``` Command should flag: missing replacement in rota, payroll-affects -> require finance sign-off, blackout -> require HR ACK.

ben: For UX, if HR/finance ack is required we can set a "pending approvals" status and DM the approvers with one-click approve link. Keeps manager rotation flow clean.

hr-bot: automated: Note created in HR tracker: "Contractor partial-day blackout swap". Added checklist: manager ok, replacement in rota, timezone specified, HR ack if contractor, finance ack if payroll-affects.

leo: Action items: 1) infra: add timezone fields + contractor flag to `/pto-swap` (ETA: 72h) 2) hr: confirm contractor ack language and add to policy page (ETA: EOD Fri) 3) finance: confirm payroll-affect criteria (ETA: 48h). I'll draft a short help text for the command.

emily: I'll coordinate with finance. Also let's add a fallback contact for last-minute coverage (on-call lead).

olivia: Thanks all. If we get these changes in the command we'll reduce manual HR churn. Closing once infra PR and HR policy blurb are live. :white_check_mark:
